calls.statement: SELECT * FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period IN (1,2,3) ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_before, COUNT(DISTINCT r.business_date) AS ctrl_days
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS per_day, c.ctrl_net, ROUND(ss.net_sales - c.ctrl_net,2) AS gap, c.ctrl_days
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctrl c ON c.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank

SELECT 'dup_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(c-1),0) AS extra FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(c-1),0) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_returns', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(c-1),0) FROM (SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_current_store', COUNT(*), 0 FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_on_closed_days', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id<900 AND NOT d.is_trading_day
UNION ALL
SELECT 'kuopio_sales_in_refit', COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount),0) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=125 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-15' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'staff_purchase', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.staff_purchase_flag AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store999_or_test', COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'max_sale_date_loaded', COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date > DATE '2026-06-28' AND sale_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
